title: Nhà thuốc gần nhất ở đâu?

summary: Different ways to say "Where is the nearest pharmacy?" in Vietnam, with the phrase to start with, useful forms, and related next steps.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Nhà thuốc gần nhất ở đâu? answers the traveler question "Where is the nearest pharmacy" in doctors, pharmacies, symptoms, and medication. This is for when you need the nearest pharmacy, not just any pharmacy. Its job is turning the problem into something the other person can point to, type, or mark on a map. sections.title: Why it matters
sections.body: Health phrases need to be simple because the other person may need to act quickly or ask a follow-up. For "Where is the nearest pharmacy", the useful move is turning the problem into something the other person can point to, type, or mark on a map. If the answer is longer than a point or a place name, ask them to show it on your phone.
